description: #749 refusal regressions: an anchor-anchored path call is trusted bookkeeping only when its remaining arguments are demonstrably static. A pathlib anchor chain whose joinpath argument is request-controlled, an anchor call whose tail argument is user-controlled, __dirname + req.query, req.query/argv operands, and an upload-named operand bound by an adjacent untrusted assignment (one-hop def/use) — all REFUSE trusted-neutralization and fire untrusted_source_join: path_handling kind, flag, and provenance.
